title: Ordering-equivalence suite
statement: The T020 candidate must add an ordering-equivalence suite that proves, in both the C++ decoder and the Python reference, that equivalent plan representations produce one canonical body and digest; that the declared per-collection ordering, unique-key, and duplicate-free activationOrder rules hold; and that diagnostics are ordered deterministically across equivalent inputs.
verification_intent: CTest cases T20OrderingEquivalence.* and the T020 pytest ordering cases; trusted unit and integration measures.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical bytes and digests are equal across member-order, whitespace, and integral-number variants in both languages.
Each identity-bearing collection is asserted in declared key order and a reversed collection is rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE.
The decoded diagnostics and outcome are identical across equivalent inputs.
